bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to economic development; appropriating money for a grant to Interfaith Action for workforce development.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; INTERFAITH ACTION WORKFORCE DEVELOPMENT. +]

[+$....... in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to Interfaith Action to support workforce training, job placement assistance, and employer connections for individuals experiencing housing instability. Grant proceeds may be used to support licensure and certification in high-demand health care fields, expand child care workforce training, and develop employer partnerships for direct hiring pathways. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to economic development; appropriating money for a grant to Interfaith Action for workforce development.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; INTERFAITH ACTION WORKFORCE DEVELOPMENT.

$....... in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to Interfaith Action to support workforce training, job placement assistance, and employer connections for individuals experiencing housing instability. Grant proceeds may be used to support licensure and certification in high-demand health care fields, expand child care workforce training, and develop employer partnerships for direct hiring pathways.
